slides.headline: India's electronics exports jumped 57% in a single month.
Electronic goods exports hit $5.92 billion in July 2026
slides.body: Up from $3.76 billion in July 2025 - a 57.4% year-on-year jump, the third-fastest-growing export category that month, per Commerce Ministry data.

slides.headline: India's fastest July export growth in four years.
slides.body: Total merchandise exports rose 19.63% to $44.24 billion that month. Combined goods and services exports climbed 13.31% to $80.14 billion - the strongest July on record in four years.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: Electronics used to be something India imported.
slides.body: A category that once ran as a trade deficit is now one of the fastest-growing export lines in the country's economy. That shift doesn't happen in one month - it happens because factory capacity was already there when demand arrived.
